answer: The service that failed first was **payments-db** at **02:14:07**, when its disk filled to 100%. The root cause was **disk space exhaustion** on /var/lib/pg ("No space left on device"), which caused WAL checkpoint failures and made the database unavailable to downstream services (checkout, orders). The fix was purging old WAL archives (38 GB freed, disk back to 61%) at 02:52:18. payments-db resumed accepting writes at **03:05:33**, and the incident INC-4471 was formally resolved at **03:41:00**.
